g.text: View from south looking north · west at left · T1 terminates at T-E · bottom edge at common wall-top datum · column-supported framing
Height is set by the roof underside. Six equal panel bays are a drawing assumption. Panel dimensions are centerline spacing, not clear cabinet openings.
Rectangular central bays require designed moment connections / Vierendeel action; end diagonals alone are not a complete truss design.
T1 bottom edge = 8 ft 2½ in; top edge = 15′ 3¼″ above ground, at the roof underside. No gap above T1. Loads go to column-supported framing.
Member widths, welds, bearing seats, lateral bracing and cabinet loads remain to be designed.
